_law: FRONT AXIS IS ASSERTED AT INGEST, LIKE SCALE (debate proposal 1, owner 'ลุยเต็มที่ ผมอนุมัติทุกอย่าง' 2026-08-25). Every model id a spec mass names carries a MEASURED native-front row here: front_deg = the azimuth (+X=0, +Y=90) the mesh's functional front points at when placed with rot 0, measured by pipeline/scripts/front_probe.py (four orthographic elevations, sighted-signed) — or null with no_front_reason for a rotation-invariant mass. build_room.model_rot FAILS CLOSED on a missing row: before 2026-08-26 it defaulted a missing entry to -90.0, which is how the Asta nightstands shipped facing the wall BF14 with a gate claiming 'verified from crop' (his refutation the same night), and how the vanity tub chair rendered 90 degrees off in every frame since it entered the spec, unnoticed.
_convention: S elevation shows the front -> -90 | E -> 0 | N -> 90 | W -> 180. THE LAW (build_room.py): place_model.rot = spec_rot - 90 - front_deg. A mass whose model has a numeric front_deg may not carry a typed `rot`; it declares `facing_derive` ({"away_from_wall": "E"} / {"toward_wall": "W"}) and the rot is derived (R9 applied to rotation).
